evals.prompt: Learn PR/issue conventions from this repo and generate a content policy so other skills can follow it.
evals.expected_output: Agent gates to GitHub-only, samples recent merged PRs/issues/commits, synthesizes a project-level policy with PR/issue/linking/conventions sections, and writes/updates the policy marker block in tooling-appropriate locations (including .github/content-policy.md). It then confirms which files were updated and summarizes the key extracted conventions.

evals.prompt: Generate a content policy for our Jira workflow (issues in Jira, PRs in GitHub). Use the Jira part as the source of truth.
evals.expected_output: Agent should not “widen” the skill into Jira-only management; it gates to GitHub-only content learning and asks which GitHub repo/PR/issue to learn from, or it limits output to GitHub-native policy content. No Jira-only policy should be produced.
